_about: Lattice types for the Crystal Lattice Builder. Which sites hold particles, particles per cell and coordination number are computed in rules.js from the site positions; only the wording lives here.

note.en: Particles sit only at the 8 corners. Each corner is shared by 8 cells, so one cell owns 8 × ⅛ = 1 particle. Each particle touches 6 neighbours.
note.ms: Zarah hanya berada di 8 bucu. Setiap bucu dikongsi oleh 8 sel, jadi satu sel memiliki 8 × ⅛ = 1 zarah. Setiap zarah menyentuh 6 jiran.

note.en: Particles at the 8 corners plus 1 in the centre of the cube. One cell owns 8 × ⅛ + 1 = 2 particles. Each particle touches 8 neighbours.
note.ms: Zarah di 8 bucu serta 1 di tengah kubus. Satu sel memiliki 8 × ⅛ + 1 = 2 zarah. Setiap zarah menyentuh 8 jiran.

note.en: Particles at the 8 corners plus 1 in the middle of each of the 6 faces. A face is shared by 2 cells, so one cell owns 8 × ⅛ + 6 × ½ = 4 particles. Each particle touches 12 neighbours.
note.ms: Zarah di 8 bucu serta 1 di tengah setiap 6 muka. Satu muka dikongsi oleh 2 sel, jadi satu sel memiliki 8 × ⅛ + 6 × ½ = 4 zarah. Setiap zarah menyentuh 12 jiran.

note.en: Cl⁻ ions sit at the corners and face centres; Na⁺ ions sit at the edge centres and the middle. Ions of opposite charge alternate, so each ion touches 6 of the other kind. One cell owns 4 Na⁺ and 4 Cl⁻.
note.ms: Ion Cl⁻ berada di bucu dan tengah muka; ion Na⁺ berada di tengah tepi dan di tengah kubus. Ion yang bercas bertentangan berselang-seli, jadi setiap ion menyentuh 6 ion jenis lain. Satu sel memiliki 4 Na⁺ dan 4 Cl⁻.
